entities.name: Antonio López de Ayala y Velasco, Count of Fuensalida
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Antonio López de Ayala Velasco y Cardeñas (?–1709) was a Spanish noble and politician. He was Count of Fuensalida and Colmenar, and Grande of Spain. He was successively viceroy of Navarra, governor of Galicia, Viceroy of Sardinia and Governor of the Duchy of Milan.
